source.reason: [CONVERSION] is a weapon ability GW's datasheets define per weapon, each with its own range (the Faction Pack's Armiger Moirax conversion beam cannon: "more than 12""; its Knight Castellan/Valiant profile: "more than 24""). The app's lists have one such weapon, the Knight Defender's conversion beam obliterator, so the glossary entry is that datasheet's wording (RULE_SRC names it). GW's Faction Pack does not reprint the Knight Defender datasheet; the Wahapedia Knight Defender datasheet (the codex) is the only source of these words, which texts.js does not search for glossary entries.

judgement.change: A unit whose DATASHEETS row another list already has takes the row's stats, weapon values, abilities (words, tags, labels, defs) and Rules line; a value a rule of the list changes stays the list's (own), a rule only the list brings is appended; every difference is listed in the report ("Kept from the datasheet row"); derive.js labels are not re-written on those abilities.
BSData's "Invulnerable Save (X+*)" is kept (BSData's words) when GW's datasheet prints the INSV* X+* box with a condition footnote, instead of being dropped as an ability GW does not print.
A faction army rule that one of the unit's abilities is tagged with ("Defender's Duty (Bondsman)") stays on the Rules line though the datasheet's ARMY RULES box does not list it.
Damaged-band label skip is case-insensitive ("Damaged: 1-9 Wounds Remaining"); an ability renamed by GW is matched with either apostrophe; hand file `na`.

"INSV* 4+ * against ranged attacks only" is every model's 4+* (a condition, not model names); each weapon keyword span is read to its own matching close (Wahapedia's "conversion" has no tooltip span; also fixes the Norn Assimilator's HARPOONED, read by no gate step).

The options inside every catalogue link to the Show/Hide Options entry are offered (the Imperial Knights catalogue's "Show Imperial Agents"; rootNode kept only the Agents of the Imperium catalogue's link).
